previous_versions.body: There is a proposal for how to do this in #2667
There is a proposal for how to do this in #[#2667](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/pull/2667)

> "V12.1 File Upload and Content" - it is just weird combo. Should be renamed to send the message "accepting and validating files during file upload". But is file upload the only way to send a file to the application? It may come from some other web service, maybe it is too much to call it an upload.

Some maybe call it "File Upload and Content Checking" and then in the section text explain that files could also be received in other ways?

> "V12.4 File Storage" - requirements (proposed as 12.4.3 and 12.4.4) moved there from "File execution" do not match with the section title. If to rename it to "Using and serving stored? files" it can be merged with "V12.5 File Download"

So maybe we need to rename to "Storing, Processing and Serving Files". Of the requirements here:

| # | Description | Comment |
| :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **12.4.1** | [MODIFIED] Verify that files uploaded or generated by untrusted input which are stored in a public folder are not executable as server-side program code when accessed directly by an end user. | **Clearly a combination of storing and serving files.** |
| **12.4.2** | Verify that files obtained from untrusted sources are scanned by antivirus scanners to prevent upload and serving of known malicious content. | **Maybe this should get moved into the "File Upload and Content Checking" section?** |
| **12.4.3** | [MODIFIED, MERGED FROM 12.3.1, 12.3.2, 12.3.3, 5.3.9] Verify that file operations avoid using user-submitted filenames or file metadata when creating file paths to protect against path traversal, local or remote file inclusion (LFI, RFI), and server-side request forgery (SSRF) attacks. Instead, use either internally generated or trusted data for file I/O operations. If user-submitted filenames or file metadata must be used, strict validation and sanitization must be applied. | **Clearly processing, probably storing and maybe serving.** |
| **12.4.4** | [ADDED] Verify that server-side file processing such as file decompression ignores user-provided path information to prevent vulnerabilities such as zip slip. | **Clearly processing and almost certainly implies storing.** |

I agree that with this title change we could also merge in the requirements from "File Download"

What do you think?

- V12.2 File Integrity
- V12.3 Save File Handling
- V12.4 File Storage
